capture_source: live capture 2026-11-26, ABAP Platform 2025 (kernel 916): saprfclib submitting a one-call unit (STFC_CONNECTION, REQUTEXT 'our-bg-one') with create_unit(), then get_unit_state() and confirm_unit(). Server replies in order: interface and DDIC lookups for BGRFC_DEST_SHIP and STFC_CONNECTION, the submit, the state query (COMMITTED), the confirm.
sanitised: length-preserving, in ASCII and UTF-16LE: server address -> 198.51.100.9, client host -> 'host1', operating-system user -> 'osuser000001'.
